name: VerilogEval v2 — Spec-to-RTL
protocol: VerilogEval v2 corrected 156-task human set, Specification-to-RTL, zero-shot, temperature 0, top-p 0.01, n=1, official extraction and Icarus Verilog v12 simulation. Completion, one-shot, stochastic, v1, and MachineEval rows are excluded.

explanation.en: The score is the fraction of 156 corrected v2 tasks whose single zero-shot RTL response compiles and passes Icarus Verilog functional simulation.
explanation.zh: 分数是 156 个修订后 v2 task 中，单次 zero-shot RTL 回答能够编译并通过 Icarus Verilog 功能仿真的比例。

summary.en: VerilogEval v2 measures whether models can translate digital-hardware specifications into functionally correct SystemVerilog RTL modules.
summary.zh: VerilogEval v2 测试模型能否把数字电路自然语言规格转换成功能正确的 SystemVerilog RTL 模块。

task_format.en: The model receives a natural-language hardware specification and port interface, then generates one complete SystemVerilog TopModule.
task_format.zh: 模型会收到自然语言硬件规格和端口接口，再生成一个完整的 SystemVerilog TopModule。
